title: Phase 1 of the Renters’ Rights Act 2026 | SDS Blog

meta.name: description
meta.content: Phase 1 of the Renters’ Rights Act came into force on 1 May 2026. Learn what the new rules mean for tenants, landlords, evictions, rent increases and disrepair.

headings.text: Phase 1 of the Renters’ Rights Act May 1st 2026
What is Phase 1 of the Renters’ Rights Act?
Landlords must now use valid possession grounds
Tenants can end their tenancy with notice
Rent increases must follow stricter rules
Rent in advance is now capped
Discrimination against tenants with children or benefits is unlawful
Tenants have stronger rights to request pets
Landlords must provide the official Information Sheet
What should tenants do if their landlord is not following the rules?
